## Guardrails

- [ ] No new panic/unwrap/expect/todo
- [ ] No diagnostic result used as conformance
- [ ] No broad compatibility claim
- [ ] Specs updated if needed
- [ ] Generated docs updated if needed
- [ ] Reports regenerated if needed
